description:
Summary of work: 
 Our team has developed plug-ins in HTML, JS, Jquery for some of our dashboards, we're looking for a good fit here on to extend our current work. 
 Based on this - we're currently looking for someone who understands, develops, debug and communicate good ideas on JQuery plugins -  fn. extend etc
 
 Can maintain or create a modular data pattern for widgets with AJAX / posting data back to server using AJAX requests, including settings
 For e.g. we want to capture the location of the widgets, settings and POST it back, have you done anything like this, please explain.
 
 Experience with charting lib's 
 Will you be able to create maintainable code
 What tools do you use, or have used, comfortable with, name your tool chain,
 Optional - do you know web API
 

 Core skill needed is Javascript, Jquery UI
 

 

 

 Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled. 
 Selected candidates will be contacted in less than a week. Mapjects is an equal opportunity employer
 Pay commensurate with experience. Mapjects offers an excellent benefit package and is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

 please email word copy of resume to 
 ensure it has your contact information, and phone number to reach you. 
 
 dev@mapjects.com
